# Naometria Translation — Volume 1, Pages 321-420

## Translation

[Page 321]

...of the year of Christ 30 predicted: so that from that year of the Lord in 1590, this prophecy of the Lord begins to be fulfilled, speaking of the second advent: "I will take you from the nations, gather you from all the countries and bring you into your own land," and I will increase them and I saw.
